CustomField.formula: IF(ISNULL( PF_Date_Closed__c ), TODAY() - DATEVALUE (CreatedDate), PF_Date_Closed__c - DATEVALUE (CreatedDate))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Displays the number of days the project item has aged since created. If the project item is still open, then it is calculated as Today - Created Date. If the project item is closed, then it is calculated as Closed Date - Created Date.
CustomField.label: Age (In Days)
